description: Trigger precision eval: verify material-analysis activates on material structure/performance analysis queries and NOT on bulk modification, project audit, or lighting queries

cases.query: M_Character_Skin 머테리얼이 인스트럭션 300개 넘는다고 경고 뜨는데, 어떤 노드가 비용 많이 잡아먹는지 분석해줘. Subsurface 쪽이 의심됨
cases.reason: Korean material performance analysis with instruction count warning and suspect area

cases.query: 머테리얼 분석 — M_Landscape_AutoMaterial material structure 보여줘. 8 texture samples 사용
cases.reason: English material analysis with sampler limit error and platform constraint

cases.query: M_Water_Ocean 머테리얼 노드 구조 보여줘. 파도 디스플레이스먼트에 WorldPositionOffset 쓰고 있는데 VertexInterpolator 최적화가 제대로 되어 있는지 확인하고 싶어
cases.reason: Korean water material node structure with WPO and vertex interpolator check

cases.query: M_Weapon_Base 머테리얼 인스턴스가 15개 있는데, 부모 머테리얼의 파라미터 구조가 어떻게 되어 있는지 분석해줘. StaticSwitchParameter로 분기 타는 부분이 있을 거야
cases.reason: Korean parent material parameter structure analysis with static switch

cases.query: material graph analysis for MI_Glass_Frosted - the refraction looks broken after the 5.4 upgrade. need to see if the Fresnel node is still connected to Opacity and if the blend mode is correct
cases.reason: English material instance analysis post-engine-upgrade with specific node concern

cases.query: M_VFX_Fire 머테리얼 성능 이슈 봐줘. 파티클 1000개 이상 스폰되면 프레임 뚝 떨어지는데 머테리얼 복잡도 때문인지 Overdraw 때문인지 구분해야 해
cases.reason: Korean VFX material performance with particle count and overdraw concern

cases.query: M_Terrain_Blend4Layer 노드 연결 구조 보여줘. LandscapeLayerBlend에서 4개 레이어 각각 Normal, Roughness, BaseColor 어떻게 연결되어 있는지. HeightBlend 세팅도 확인하고 싶어
cases.reason: Korean landscape material layer blend structure with height blend setting

cases.query: analyze the material graph of M_Hologram_UI - it uses a custom HLSL node for scan line effects and I need to understand how the EmissiveColor is calculated from the ScreenPosition input
cases.reason: English material analysis with custom HLSL and emissive calculation

cases.query: M_Decal_Blood 머테리얼 DBuffer 설정이 맞는지 확인해줘. 데칼이 메시 위에 렌더링 안 되는 이슈가 있어서 BlendMode이랑 DecalBlendMode 분석 필요
cases.reason: Korean decal material analysis with DBuffer and blend mode rendering issue

cases.query: M_Character_Cloth 머테리얼에서 Cloth 시뮬레이션용 WorldPositionOffset이랑 Normal 연결 구조 파악해줘. TwoSidedSign 노드가 제대로 들어가 있는지도 체크
cases.reason: Korean cloth material WPO and normal structure with two-sided check

cases.query: M_Character_Skin 머테리얼을 출력 핀별로 흐름 단계를 나눠서 분석해줘. BaseColor(색감) / Normal·WorldPositionOffset(모양) / Roughness·Metallic(질감) 각각 어떤 노드 구간으로 구성되는지, 공용 입력부(UV 변형 같은)는 따로 묶어서 보여줘
cases.reason: Korean Part 4 flow-stage-split request (Issue #14979): output-pin backtrace + per-stage segmentation + shared-input grouping is exactly the stage-split workflow

cases.query: break down M_Landscape_AutoMaterial into flow stages — trace each output pin (BaseColor, Normal, Roughness) back through its upstream subgraph, cut the subgraph into stages at the Lerp/TextureSample/MaterialFunction boundaries, and label what each stage does
cases.reason: English Part 4 flow-stage-split request (Issue #14979): output-pin backtrace + cut-point segmentation + stage labeling maps to the stage-split algorithm

cases.query: M_TeamColorBasic 머테리얼 분석해줘 — 기능군별 담당 파라미터, 기본값, 제작자 조합, 각 기능 끄는 법까지 카탈로그로 정리하고 MI 패밀리 diff 표도 보여줘
cases.reason: Korean Part 5 feature-catalog request (Issue #16326): 기능군→파라미터→기본값→조합→끄는 법 catalog + MI family diff is exactly the compare_mi_family + get_nodes synthesis. Pure-analysis framing ('분석해줘') wins material-analysis under priority arbitration; avoids higher-priority positive triggers (만들어/생성/how to) and negative_patterns (파라미터 값 바꿔)

cases.query: analyze M_TeamColorBasic material structure — group features, list parameters, defaults, disable conditions, and an MI family diff table
cases.reason: English Part 5 feature-catalog request (Issue #16326): feature grouping + parameters + defaults + disable conditions + MI family diff maps to the catalog workflow. 'analyze ... material structure' triggers material-analysis; 'disable conditions' deliberately avoids ue-explain's 'how to disable' trigger
